answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1701 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the harbor. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the anchor queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. The jetty index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 499 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
